dialogues.jp:
シャワーを浴びて、腹いっぱいにご飯を詰め込
んで、歯を磨いてベッドにもぐりこんだ。
dialogues.en:
I stuff down some food, brush my teeth, take a shower, and
tumble into bed.
dialogues.text:
I stuff down some food, brush my teeth, take a shower, and
tumble into bed.

dialogues.jp:
「ちくしょう……土曜日の昼間っから、どうし
　て寝なきゃいけないんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Darn! Why do I have to go to sleep on a Saturday
afternoon?"
dialogues.text:
"Darn! Why do I have to go to sleep on a Saturday
afternoon?"

dialogues.jp:
これが授業の後か、授業中ならいくらでも寝て
やるのだが、昨日の爆睡でいっこうに眠くなら
ない。
dialogues.en:
If this was after class, or in the middle of class, I could
can sleep as much as I want. But after a long sleep from
yesterday, I'm not sleepy at all now.
dialogues.text:
If this was after class, or in the middle of class, I could
can sleep as much as I want. But after a long sleep from
yesterday, I'm not sleepy at all now.

dialogues.jp: じれったくて仕方がない。

「そもそも、早く会いたければ急いで眠れって
　のが矛盾してるんだよな……」
dialogues.en:
"First of all, it doesn't make any sense that if I go to
sleep quicker, then I can see her sooner."
dialogues.text:
"First of all, it doesn't make any sense that if I go to
sleep quicker, then I can see her sooner."

dialogues.jp:
枕から顔を上げると、さくらの飼っていた猫が
窓の外で鳴いていた。
dialogues.en:
When I lift my head, I see her cat purring outside at the
windowsill.
dialogues.text:
When I lift my head, I see her cat purring outside at the
windowsill.

dialogues.jp: 窓をあけて、胸の中に抱きかかえる。
dialogues.en: I took her in from the window and held her.
dialogues.text: I took her in from the window and held her.

dialogues.jp:
「まったく……お前のお気楽なご主人様は、ど
　こに行ったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Where the heck is your whimsical owner?"
dialogues.text: "Where the heck is your whimsical owner?"

dialogues.jp:
小さく笑って、胸に抱きかかえたままベッドに
もぐりこむ。
dialogues.en: I hide myself under the covers, still holding the cat.
dialogues.text: I hide myself under the covers, still holding the cat.

dialogues.jp:
窓が開けっ放しだったが、吹き込んでくる風と
桜の匂いが心地よくて、そのままにすることに
した。
dialogues.en:
I left the window open because the breeze and the scent of
cherry blossoms felt so good.
dialogues.text:
I left the window open because the breeze and the scent of
cherry blossoms felt so good.

dialogues.jp: 誰かの夢を見たいと願うなんて。
dialogues.en: That I've wanted to see somebody else's dream.
dialogues.text: That I've wanted to see somebody else's dream.

dialogues.jp: 音夢のこととか、不思議な力とか……。
dialogues.en: It's not about Nemu or a strange power...
dialogues.text: It's not about Nemu or a strange power...

dialogues.jp: そんなものを追求したいんじゃなくて。
dialogues.en: That is not what I'm looking for.
dialogues.text: That is not what I'm looking for.

dialogues.jp: 俺はさくらに会いたかった。
dialogues.en: I just want to see Sakura.
dialogues.text: I just want to see Sakura.

dialogues.en: ◆A wish to meet in a dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆A wish to meet in a dream◆

dialogues.jp: さくらに会いたい。その一心で眠りにつく。
dialogues.en: I went to sleep out of sheer desire to see Sakura.
dialogues.text: I went to sleep out of sheer desire to see Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
誰かの夢を見たいと願うなんて、はじめてのこ
とだった。
dialogues.en: I never wanted to see somebody else's dream before.
dialogues.text: I never wanted to see somebody else's dream before.
